title: Oil Infused Dutch Fruit Pudding
description: A yeasty and silky Dutch dessert featuring dried fruit and infused oil, friendly to the ayurvedic tamasic diet. This energizing dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.

ingredients.name: infused oil
ingredients.notes: coconut oil with cinnamon and ginger

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the dried fruit, infused oil, and yeast.
Let the mixture sit for 10 minutes to allow the yeast to activate.
Add the flour, sugar, water, and salt to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Knead the batter for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the batter in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Pour the batter into a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the vanilla extract over the pudding and serve warm.
